summary.intent: Execute Phase 19.2 gap closure plans to address verification failures: register PERF-09 in REQUIREMENTS.md and collect definitive matched-environment load test baselines comparing three optimization states (no opts, SDK concurrent pins, SDK + pebbleds).
summary.outcome: PERF-09 was registered and a four-run load test protocol (concurrency probe + three baselines at 50 clients) was completed, revealing that concurrent SDK pins alone hurt performance at high concurrency but pebbleds datastore restored and improved it — the two optimizations are synergistic.

repo: Kubo/IPFS throughput plateaus around 3.5–4 ops/s at 10+ concurrent clients regardless of client count — the bottleneck is IPFS write throughput, not the API layer
50 concurrent clients is the highest clean load test run (zero errors, completes within timeout); 75+ clients trigger JWT token expiry and 401 errors under sustained load
Concurrent SDK pins (Promise.allSettled) double the simultaneous Kubo pin load — this hurts flatfs (p95 18.7s→44.7s) but pebbleds handles it (p95 16.3s, better than baseline)
DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL in apps/api/.env should point to someguy on 192.168.133.114:8190 for staging-representative tests; localhost:3001 is mock-ipns-routing
Load test secrets (LOAD_TEST_SECRET, THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET) must be passed as inline shell env vars — vitest does not load dotenv
THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET is sent as X-Throttle-Bypass header; BypassableThrottlerGuard skips rate limiting on non-production environments when this matches
LOAD_TEST_SECRET is used in POST /auth/test-login body for test account creation; API checks against TEST_LOGIN_SECRET

workflow: Pre-optimization baselines collected in different environments (staging vs localhost) are non-definitive — matched-environment comparison is essential for valid performance claims
Concurrency probe (incrementing client count until errors appear) is necessary before committing to a baseline client count — throughput plateau and error boundary are not obvious upfront
When running background bash tasks, working directory matters — cd to repo root before restoring files with git checkout
Git checkout of individual files for testing optimization stages requires care about CWD; run from repo root to avoid path resolution issues

friction: API server was not running and had to be started manually mid-session — no auto-start or healthcheck before tests
vitest does not load dotenv, so load test secrets cannot be set in .env files — must be passed as inline shell env vars; this was discovered mid-session
